title: Transit Equity Project
summary: A research pack scoring frequent, accessible, sheltered transit service against population and deprivation need.
sourceNote: GTFS-derived service metrics combined with census and deprivation context. The full weighting model lives in Index Lab, which opens with this exact recipe.
details: A research pack for reviewing transit access against population context with a transparent equity scoring recipe.
The story keeps service context visible while the lab remains available for weighting changes and boundary-level experiments.
